title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have your players been told to leave?
MLB has shut down ML and MiLB spring training all players are able to return home.
Have you told the players yet?
We have a meeting later. But the players Union probably has already informed them.
Meeting with team and coaches and stuff? What time?
Later this afternoon. Everyone is scattered some guys we may simply call if they can’t get here.
